run_preprocess_scenes: run the preprocessing script to generate and cache CLIP and DINO featurized pointclouds for 3D scenes
build_pointcloud_cache: build a cache of featurized pointclouds using CLIP and DINO features from camera views
create_feature_lifter: create a FeatureLifter3D instance from a config YAML file to lift frames into 3D features
review_preprocess_scenes: review the preprocess_scenes function that iterates through scenes and caches featurized pointclouds
summarize_locate3d_preprocessing: summarize the Locate3D dataset preprocessing pipeline that generates cached pointcloud features
